note: Rewritten from the species-level description by Holmgren (1913); the original is in German. The adult is recorded in the original as "unbekannt"; only the soldier and worker are described, measurements in mm. The worker head width is damaged by OCR in the scanned text (rendered as "0,i*ö") and has not been entered. The original notes that the species may be only a race (Rasse) of sordidus.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head black, the tip of the nasus also black; body pale brown, antennae and femora tinged with brown. Head with a few setae, abdominal tergites with a row of posterior setae. Head wider and thicker than in sordidus. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 4 longer than segment 3. Measurements: body length 3.7—4 mm, head with nasus 1.67 mm, head without nasus 0.83 mm, head width 1.03 mm, pronotum width 0.57 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: No mature workers available; the workers at hand are pale, measurements: body length 3.5 mm, pronotum width 0.57 mm.
